headline: Meta launches Muse Charm, a palm-sized AI gadget for its new Muse assistant
summary: Meta has unveiled the Muse Charm, a new palm-sized gadget specifically designed for its Muse AI assistant. This device is part of a broader series of AI-powered hardware announcements from the company.
details: Meta officially announced the Muse Charm, a new palm-sized gadget designed specifically for its Muse AI assistant. This device is part of a broader series of AI-powered hardware unveiled by the company.

The Muse Charm aims to provide a dedicated physical interface for interacting with Meta's AI. Its compact, palm-sized form factor suggests a focus on portability and ease of access to the AI assistant.

Other announcements included camera-free glasses, indicating Meta's push into various AI-centric hardware form factors. The company is expanding its ecosystem of AI devices beyond its existing smart glasses line.

Some outlets have described the Muse Charm as a 'Tamagotchi-like wearable,' hinting at an interactive and potentially personalized experience with the AI. This suggests a focus on user engagement and a unique approach to AI interaction.
